faces.name: Insatiable Avarice

do.reason: Spree's modes each carry an additional cost the caster really pays as the spell is cast, and no record joins a mode to such a cost: Mode.Cost is a budget price that is never paid and requires a ChooseMode budget beside it (L032), Face.additionalCosts are all mandatory rather than one-or-more chosen, and AlternativeCost replaces the mana cost instead of adding to it. Writing the two modes without their prices would cast the spell for {B}, which is a different card.
